question: What happens to yogins who have deeply cultivated a particular principle at death?
premises: Some yogins are well cultivated in a particular tattva.
At the critical moment they deliberately fix their mind on that tattva.
Focused cultivation directs the post-death movement of consciousness.
inference: Therefore, such yogins go without doubt to the very tattva in which they have been well cultivated.
plain_english: But those yogins who have become well established in a particular principle fix their mind on that very principle and, without doubt, go to it.
